comparison.objective: Candidate screens finishing media from retained washers; pr-2100 inserts and securely tightens a drill bit in a keyed chuck, then removes the key.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate tests pouring and controlled agitation of a perforated screen; pr-2100 tests axial bit insertion, pilot/pinion meshing under separating force, torque application with regrasping, centering, and key removal.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate requires ≥98% media recovery with all washers retained and no loss, contamination, or damage; pr-2100 requires specified insertion depth, ≤1 mm runout, secure torque/pull resistance, key removal, clearance, and stillness.
comparison.reason: All four specifications were available and show unrelated mechanisms and measurable outcomes; no comparison-critical rubric detail is missing.
